title: Model Improvement Can Decrease Accuracy Metrics
discussion_signal: The post uses the NBER credit-score study to illustrate a feedback problem: a scoring change can alter access to credit and thereby help produce the default outcome later used to judge the model, with the discussion extending the issue to predictive-system evaluation.
linked_research_question: When a predictive score changes treatment, how much of its later apparent accuracy reflects a self-fulfilling intervention rather than stable borrower risk?
limits: Post translates a working paper into a broader model-evaluation lesson
The discussion includes scaled illustrative numbers that are not a separate observed cohort
